items.zh: MONA美术馆外的冬季暮色，混凝土墙面上倒映着德文特河的冷光，一只海鸥停在栏杆上，天空低垂呈灰蓝，棕褐色调在枯草与锈蚀铁件中低回，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 亚瑟港（Port Arthur）流放遗址的砂岩墙残垣特写，苔藓爬上石缝，一扇无玻璃的哥特窗框对着天空，光线温暖地照在风化的石面上，棕褐色调渗透整幅画面，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of Port Arthur penal ruins sandstone wall remnant, moss climbing stone cracks, a glassless gothic window frame against sky, light warmly illuminating weathered stone, brown tones permeating the whole image, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从一扇黑色铁艺阳台窗望出去，怀特玛塔港（Waitemata Harbour）上白帆点点，朗伊托托岛（Rangitoto）火山锥静卧在海平线上，深蓝夜色将临，窗台上一盆蕨类植物，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 朗伊托托岛火山锥的剖面示意感画面：黑色玄武岩上覆盖着新西兰圣诞树（pohutukawa）的深绿与红花，海浪拍打岩岸，天空阴沉泛蓝黑，展现火山岛生态演替，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 高架桥港（Viaduct Harbour）傍晚，一对情侣在码头长椅上看帆船归港，旁边咖啡馆亮着暖灯，海面泛深蓝，几个人牵着狗散步，安静惬意，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 黎明时分，朗伊托托岛的轮廓在薄雾中如一艘沉默的船，海面如镜，天空从深蓝渐变到淡紫，一只信天翁掠过水面，大片留白，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: At dawn, Rangitoto Island's silhouette in thin mist like a silent ship, mirror-still sea, sky graduating deep blue to pale violet, an albatross skimming the water, ample negative space, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.en: A tui bird perched on a silver fern unfurling frond in native New Zealand bush, white throat tuft fluffy, background temperate rainforest deep green and blue-grey mist, showing island unique bird ecology, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 古巴街（Cuba Street）午后，一位街头艺人在彩色建筑前弹吉他，行人三三两两端着咖啡走过，风把衣角吹起，蓝灰色调在阴天光线中铺展，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.en: A row of wind-bent trees on hillside, all branches leaning one direction, harbour lights blurring in dusk, vast grey-blue negative space in sky, wind as protagonist of this painting, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 山坡上一栋维多利亚式木屋的外墙特写，鱼鳞板（weatherboard）漆成深蓝色已斑驳，窗框上的铁艺花纹锈蚀，一株攀缘植物从墙缝伸出，蓝灰色调渗透木纹，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 从一扇深蓝色木框窗望出去，瓦卡蒂普湖（Lake Wakatipu）碧蓝如宝石，对岸卓越山脉（The Remarkables）锯齿状雪峰倒映水中，湖边码头停着一艘蒸汽船，窗台放着一杯热茶，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through a deep blue wooden window: Lake Wakatipu jewel-blue, The Remarkables jagged snow peaks reflected in water, a steamship at lakeside dock, a cup of hot tea on sill, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 冰川侵蚀形成的U形谷剖面感画面：瓦卡蒂普湖狭长如闪电，两侧山壁陡峭，高山草甸上开着南岛特有的毛茛花，深蓝湖水与灰蓝岩壁形成冷色调，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Glacial U-shaped valley cross-section feeling: Lake Wakatipu long and lightning-shaped, steep valley walls, alpine meadow with South Island endemic buttercups, deep blue lake and grey-blue rock walls forming cool palette, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: TSS厄恩斯劳号（Earnslaw）蒸汽船甲板上，一位司炉工往炉膛添煤，烟囱冒白烟，乘客靠在栏杆上看湖景，湖水深蓝，远山覆雪，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 黎明前卓越山脉被云雾缠绕，湖面完全静止如一面深蓝镜子，岸边一棵枯树的倒影与山的倒影重叠，天空只有一线暖光，大片留白在雾中，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Pre-dawn Remarkables wreathed in cloud, lake perfectly still as deep blue mirror, a bare tree's reflection overlapping mountain reflection, sky just a line of warm light, vast negative space in mist, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 箭镇（Arrowtown）淘金时代遗留的铁皮屋顶矿工小屋，墙面斑驳，门前一棵金黄秋叶的桦树，地上散落锈蚀的淘金盘，深蓝阴影在屋檐下，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Arrowtown gold-rush era corrugated iron miner's cottage, mottled walls, a golden autumn birch tree at door, rusted gold pans scattered on ground, deep blue shadows under eaves, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从一扇木雕花窗（毛利会堂风格）望出去，罗托鲁瓦湖面上蒸汽升腾，远处一座毛利会堂（wharenui）的三角山墙隐约可见，金橄榄色调在蒸汽与暮光中弥漫，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through a Maori meeting house style carved window: steam rising from Lake Rotorua, a wharenui triangular gable faintly visible in distance, golden olive tones pervading steam and dusk light, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 地热区切面：彩色硅华台地上冒着蓝绿色热泉，旁边是翻涌的灰色泥浆池，蒸汽中硫化物结晶呈金黄色，展示板块交界处的地热奇观，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Geothermal cross-section: blue-green hot spring bubbling on colorful sinter terrace, grey mud pool churning beside, sulfur crystals golden yellow in steam, showing plate boundary geothermal wonders, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 毛利村落里，一位女性在地热蒸汽口上用地传统方式蒸煮hangi食物，亚麻围裙，孩子在旁边好奇张望，金橄榄色光线穿过蒸汽，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: In a Maori village, a woman cooking hangi food over geothermal steam vent in traditional way, flax apron, child peering curiously beside, golden olive light through steam, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 清晨地热谷中，蒸汽从地面每一处裂缝升起，如大地在呼吸，一棵枯死的树矗立在硫磺色地面上，金橄榄色调笼罩整片寂静，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Morning in geothermal valley, steam rising from every ground crack as if earth breathes, a dead tree standing on sulfur-colored ground, golden olive tones enveloping the silence, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 毛利会堂内墙上一块雕刻板（poupou）特写，螺旋纹与祖先面孔用深色木刻出，表面有岁月磨光的光泽，金橄榄色光线从侧窗照入，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of a carved wall panel (poupou) inside a wharenui, spiral patterns and ancestor faces in dark wood, surface polished by time, golden olive light from side window, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.en: View through colonial green louvered shutters: inter-island ferries in Suva harbour, coconut palms lining the street, white colonial walls glowing in tropical light, deep green tones echoed in palm shadows and seawater, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.en: A Collared Lory parrot perched on breadfruit branch in Fiji tropical rainforest, plumage deep blue and red, surrounded by layered green ferns and vines, showing South Pacific island endemic birds, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.en: Suva Municipal Market, a Fijian woman seated behind her stall piled with taro, cassava and tropical fruits, wearing a flower garland and smiling, green tones pervading vegetable leaves and roof shadows, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 一朵鸡蛋花（frangipani）漂浮在平静的潟湖水面上，周围是倒影中的椰树与天空，水呈翡翠绿，画面极度安静，只有花瓣的白与黄点缀，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 一块斐济传统树皮布（masi/tapa）平铺展示，棕色几何三角纹样印在米色布面上，旁边放着制布用的木槌，绿色调从窗外热带植物中透入，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.en: View through a Spanish colonial arched iron window: blue Cebu harbour with bangka outrigger boats, Magellan's Cross pavilion roof faintly visible, blue tones echoed in sea-sky and window shadows, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 喀什绿洲与塔克拉玛干沙漠交界的生态剖面，胡杨林沿喀什噶尔河生长，金黄胡杨叶与赭红沙丘形成鲜明对比，展现荒漠绿洲的生命力，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Ecological cross-section where the Kashgar oasis meets the Taklamakan Desert, Euphrates poplars growing along the Kashgar River, golden poplar leaves contrasting sharply with ochre-red dunes, showing the vitality of a desert oasis, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 老城巷子里一位维吾尔族铜匠在作坊门口敲打铜壶，火星微溅，旁边老人坐在土墙根喝茯茶，孩童蹲在地上玩弹珠，生活气息浓厚，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: In an old town alley a Uyghur coppersmith hammering a copper ewer at his workshop doorway, tiny sparks flying, an elder sitting against the earthen wall drinking brick tea, a child squatting playing marbles, rich everyday life, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 正午阳光从窄巷上方一线天倾泻而下，照亮飞扬的尘土与一面土墙上的雕花窗影，巷底幽暗，光与影的沉思构图，大量留白，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Noon sunlight pouring down a slit of sky above a narrow alley, illuminating floating dust and the shadow of a carved window on an earthen wall, the alley floor in deep shade, a contemplative composition of light and shadow with ample negative space, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 喀什老城一扇百年雕花木门的特写，门板上维吾尔几何花纹与石榴纹木雕层层叠叠，木质氧化成深褐，铁门闩锈迹斑斑，岁月质感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of a century-old carved wooden door in Kashgar old town, layered Uyghur geometric and pomegranate-pattern wood carvings on the panels, wood oxidized to deep brown, the iron bolt rusted, a texture of age, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从湖畔一座江南园林的月洞门望出去，瘦西湖上五亭桥横跨水面，白塔耸立，岸边垂柳拂水、桃花初绽，色调呼应橄榄绿的窗棂与柳色，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through a moon gate of a Jiangnan garden by the lake, the Five-Pavilion Bridge spanning Slender West Lake, the White Pagoda rising, weeping willows brushing the water and peach blossoms opening on the bank, tones echoing the olive-green lattice and willow hues, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 瘦西湖水生生态特写，琼花（扬州市花）的白色聚伞花序盛放，水面浮着睡莲，一只翠鸟停在柳枝上，呈现江南园林的湿地微生态，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of Slender West Lake's aquatic ecology, the white cyme clusters of the qionghua flower (Yangzhou's city flower) in full bloom, water lilies floating on the surface, a kingfisher perched on a willow branch, showing the wetland micro-ecology of a Jiangnan garden, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 清晨湖畔茶社，几位扬州老人围坐方桌喝早茶，桌上烫干丝与三丁包子冒着热气，一人提着鸟笼，闲适的市井烟火气，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Morning at a lakeside teahouse, several elderly Yangzhou locals seated around a square table for morning tea, steaming shredded tofu and savory buns on the table, one holding a birdcage, a leisurely everyday warmth, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 月夜瘦西湖，五亭桥的剪影与水中倒影合成一轮满月，柳丝如墨线垂落，湖面留白如宣纸，诗意空灵的静思画面，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Moonlit Slender West Lake, the silhouette of the Five-Pavilion Bridge and its reflection forming a full moon, willow strands hanging like ink lines, the lake surface blank as rice paper, a poetic and ethereal meditative scene, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 扬州漆器百宝嵌工艺特写，一只清代螺钿漆盒上镶嵌的贝壳花卉在柔光下泛虹彩，盒身朱漆已现细密开片，岁月与新光的凝视，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of Yangzhou lacquerware with hundred-treasure inlay, the shell-inlaid flowers on a Qing dynasty mother-of-pearl lacquer box shimmering iridescent in soft light, the vermilion lacquer body showing fine craquelure, a gaze of age and new light, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从临河台门老宅的木格窗望出去，窄河道上一叶乌篷船穿过石拱桥，两岸白墙黛瓦挂着腊味，窗框映着墨绿河水，色调呼应青灰窗棂，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through a wooden lattice window of a riverside tai-men old house, a black-awning boat passing under a stone arch bridge on the narrow canal, white walls and dark tiles on both banks hung with cured meats, the window frame reflecting ink-green water, tones echoing the slate-green lattice, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 绍兴鉴湖湿地生态，水面菱角与菖蒲丛生，一只白鹭立于浅滩，远处是连绵的会稽山丘陵，呈现江南水乡的淡水湿地生态，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Wetland ecology of Shaoxing's Jian Lake, water caltrop and sweet flag clustering on the surface, a white egret standing on a shallow bank, the rolling Kuaiji Hills in the distance, showing the freshwater wetland ecology of a Jiangnan water town, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 清晨河边石埠头，一位绍兴妇人蹲在台阶上浣衣，棒槌轻敲，旁边乌篷船夫撑着长篙等候，水巷苏醒的温柔日常，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Early morning at a riverside stone wharf, a Shaoxing woman squatting on the steps washing clothes, a mallet tapping softly, a black-awning boatman waiting with a long pole nearby, the tender daily awakening of a water lane, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 雨后水乡，一顶乌篷船静静泊在石桥头，橹桨斜倚，水面涟漪荡开白墙倒影，雨丝如帘，留白处尽是江南的愁与静，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: A water town after rain, a black-awning boat moored quietly at a stone bridge, an oar leaning askew, ripples spreading the reflection of white walls on the water, rain like a curtain, the negative space full of Jiangnan's quiet melancholy, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 绍兴黄酒坛特写，一只封着荷叶与红纸酒标的陶坛，坛身釉色温润，旁边搁着竹提吊与一只青瓷酒盏，岁月沉淀的醇厚质感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of a Shaoxing yellow wine jar, a ceramic jar sealed with a lotus leaf and red paper label, the glaze warm and mellow, a bamboo ladle and a celadon wine cup resting beside it, the rich texture of aged years, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从篁岭徽派民居的木窗望出去，马头墙层叠的白墙黛瓦村落挂在山坡上，家家窗台晒着红辣椒与黄玉米，秋色与赭红窗框呼应，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through a wooden window of a Huizhou-style house in Huangling, a village of layered horse-head walls with white walls and dark tiles clinging to the hillside, every windowsill drying red chilies and yellow corn, autumn colors echoing the ochre-red frame, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 婺源石城晨雾中的枫香树群，红叶在薄雾里如火如霞，树下徽村炊烟升起，展现江南丘陵秋季色叶树种与地形雾的生态景观，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: A grove of sweetgum trees in morning mist at Shicheng Wuyuan, red leaves glowing like fire and rosy clouds in the thin fog, cooking smoke rising from a Huizhou village below, showing the ecological landscape of autumn color-leaf trees and terrain fog in Jiangnan hills, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 篁岭晒秋，一位农妇在竹匾上翻晒菊花与柿子，圆匾色彩斑斓铺满晒台，远处梯田层叠，劳作的喜悦与丰收的暖色，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Autumn drying in Huangling, a farm woman turning chrysanthemums and persimmons on bamboo trays, colorful round trays covering the drying platform, terraced fields layered in the distance, the joy of labor and the warm hues of harvest, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 深秋黄昏，一棵老枫树立于徽村水口，红叶落满青石板路，一只黄犬卧在门墩旁，夕照把白墙染成蜜色，留白处是秋的沉静，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Late autumn dusk, an old maple standing at the water mouth of a Huizhou village, red leaves carpeting the flagstone path, a yellow dog lying by a door pier, the setting sun dyeing white walls honey-colored, the negative space holding autumn's stillness, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 徽派建筑三雕特写，一块门楼砖雕上的人物戏文浮雕线条流畅，砖面风化泛白，缝隙里嵌着秋日的苔痕，古意与新光的对视，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of the three carvings of Huizhou architecture, a brick relief of opera figures on a gate tower with flowing lines, the brick surface weathered pale, autumn moss traces lodged in the cracks, an exchange between antiquity and new light, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从山顶气象站的钢窗望出去，长白山天池如一汪深蓝嵌在环形火山口里，池畔十六峰环抱，水面浮着薄雾，色调呼应冷灰蓝窗框，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through the steel window of a summit weather station, Heaven Lake of Changbai Mountain like a pool of deep blue set in a ring-shaped crater, sixteen peaks embracing the shore, thin mist floating on the water, tones echoing the cool slate-blue frame, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 长白山垂直植被带剖面，从山脚的针阔混交林到山腰的岳桦林再到山顶的高山苔原，呈现海拔梯度生态，天池火山口地貌清晰，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Vertical vegetation belt cross-section of Changbai Mountain, from mixed conifer-broadleaf forest at the foot to Erman's birch belt at mid-slope to alpine tundra at the summit, showing altitudinal ecology, the crater landform of Heaven Lake clearly rendered, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 秋日岳桦林带，一位护林员背着望远镜走在木栈道上，桦叶金黄，远处天池若隐若现，人与原始林的安静共处，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Autumn in the Erman's birch belt, a forest ranger with binoculars on his back walking a wooden boardwalk, birch leaves golden, Heaven Lake faintly visible in the distance, a quiet coexistence of human and primeval forest, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 冬日天池冰封，整片湖面如一块青白玉，环形雪峰静默围合，天空铅灰留白，一片亘古的寒冷与纯净引人出神，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Winter Heaven Lake frozen over, the whole surface like a slab of pale jade, ringed snow peaks enclosing it in silence, the sky a leaden grey negative space, an eternal cold and purity that draws one into reverie, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 满族萨满旧物特写，一面铜镜与系着彩布的萨满腰铃搁在桦皮盒上，铜面氧化发暗，彩布褪色，森林信仰的岁月痕迹，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of old Manchu shamanic objects, a bronze mirror and waist bells strung with colored cloth resting on a birch-bark box, the bronze darkened by oxidation, the cloth faded, the weathered traces of forest faith, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从林间木屋的方窗望出去，阿尔山驼峰岭天池如一枚碧玉嵌在密林火山口里，四周落叶松与白桦层林尽染，秋色呼应深绿窗框，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through the square window of a forest cabin, the Camel-Hump Ridge crater lake of Arxan like a piece of jade set in a wooded crater, surrounding larch and white birch in full autumn color, autumn tones echoing the deep green frame, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 阿尔山火山熔岩地貌，黑色玄武岩石塘林上长着落叶松与苔藓，杜鹃湖的湖水由火山堰塞而成，呈现火山地质的生态演替，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Volcanic lava landform of Arxan, larch and moss growing over black basalt stone fields, Azalea Lake formed by volcanic damming, showing the ecological succession of volcanic geology, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 秋日林缘，一位鄂温克族驯鹿人牵着几头驯鹿穿过白桦林，鹿角挂着苔藓，人穿着兽皮袍，林海深处的游牧生活，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: At a forest edge in autumn, an Evenki reindeer herder leading a few reindeer through a birch grove, moss dangling from the antlers, the herder in a hide robe, the nomadic life deep in the sea of trees, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 清晨不冻河上蒸腾的水雾，河岸雾凇挂满枝头，一头牛静立河中饮水，暖光穿透冷雾，留白处是北国林海的呼吸，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Steam rising from the unfreezing river at dawn, rime ice hanging on the branches along the bank, a single ox standing still in the river to drink, warm light piercing the cold mist, the negative space the breathing of a northern forest sea, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 阿尔山老火车站特写，东洋式木构小站的橙黄墙与绿铁皮顶在秋阳下斑驳，铁轨延伸进桦林，旧时代的边陲记忆，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of the old Arxan railway station, the orange-yellow walls and green tin roof of the Japanese-style timber station mottled in autumn sun, tracks extending into the birch forest, a frontier memory of a bygone era, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从临街骑楼老屋的木窗望出去，遇龙河上一叶竹筏漂过，对岸是拔地而起的喀斯特孤峰与凤尾竹，水色碧绿呼应鼠尾草绿窗框，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through a wooden window of an arcade-style old house on the street, a bamboo raft drifting on the Yulong River, karst solitary peaks and phoenix-tail bamboo rising on the far bank, the water emerald echoing the sage-green frame, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 桂林喀斯特峰林地貌剖面，石灰岩孤峰由溶蚀形成，峰间是溶蚀平原与地下河，峰顶覆盖常绿灌丛，呈现热带亚热带岩溶奇观，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Cross-section of Guilin karst peak-forest landform, limestone solitary peaks formed by dissolution, dissolution plains and underground rivers between peaks, evergreen scrub covering the summits, showing the tropical-subtropical karst wonder, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 遇龙河畔，一位老渔夫站在竹筏上撑篙，筏头立着两只鸬鹚，夕照把峰林染成剪影，传统渔猎生活的温柔瞬间，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 琉森湖的冰川湖成因与阿尔卑斯山前湖泊生态，湖水由冰川融水汇成呈碧蓝，湖岸芦苇与候鸟栖息，呈现冰蚀湖的生态，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 廊桥下的河畔，一位街头手风琴师在演奏，几位行人驻足聆听，木廊上挂着三角楣画，阳光洒在河面，悠闲的午后，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 伯尔尼高地传统木雕与牛铃特写，一只手工雕花木盒与一枚黄铜牛铃并置，木纹与铜锈温润，山民手艺的岁月质感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 从老城彩漆楼的凸窗望出去，黄金屋顶（Goldenes Dachl）的鎏金铜瓦在檐下闪光，背后北链山脉雪顶压城，色调呼应深褐窗框，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 因河谷地与北链山的高山生态，缆车直抵的石灰岩山脊上高山杜鹃与旱獭栖息，呈现阿尔卑斯东段的城市近山生态，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 老城街边咖啡馆，一位穿传统皮裤的老人读报喝咖啡，窗台摆着天竺葵，阳光斜照彩墙，蒂罗尔小城的悠闲午后，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: At an old-town street cafe, an elder in traditional leather breeches reading and drinking coffee, geraniums on the windowsill, sunlight slanting on the painted walls, a leisurely Tyrolean afternoon, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 雪夜金顶屋，鎏金檐在灯光下如一团暖火，飘雪中的彩墙空巷，留白处是阿尔卑斯冬夜的静谧与华贵，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: The Golden Roof on a snowy night, the gilded eaves like a warm flame in the lamplight, the painted walls and empty alley in falling snow, the negative space the quiet grandeur of an Alpine winter night, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从欧登塞河畔彩漆半木构小屋的木窗望出去，安徒生故居的黄色木墙与红瓦顶临水，河上白鹅游过，色调呼应深蓝窗框，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字

items.zh: 老城鹅卵石巷里，一位妇人推着自行车走过彩墙，窗台天竺葵盛放，邻人隔窗招呼，童话小城的温柔日常，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: In a cobbled old-town lane, a woman wheeling a bicycle past a painted wall, geraniums blooming on the sill, a neighbor greeting across the window, the tender daily life of a fairytale town, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 黄昏河面，一只纸船顺水漂过安徒生故居墙下，白鹅静浮，水面留白如镜，童话与乡愁的诗意沉思，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: The river at dusk, a paper boat drifting past the wall of the Andersen house, a white swan floating still, the water blank as a mirror, the poetic contemplation of fairytale and longing, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 安徒生剪纸与旧书桌特写，一张白色人物剪纸立在摊开的旧书与羽毛笔旁，纸边泛黄，童话大师手泽的岁月质感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of an Andersen paper-cut and old desk, a white figurative cut-out standing by an open old book and quill, the paper edges yellowed, the weathered hand-patina of the fairytale master, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 从大学城老楼的拱窗望出去，乌普萨拉大教堂的双尖塔与红砖立面矗立，菲里斯河畔秋叶缤纷，色调呼应石青窗框，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: View through the arched window of an old university building, the twin spires and red-brick facade of Uppsala Cathedral standing tall, autumn leaves ablaze along the Fyris River, tones echoing the slate-grey frame, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 乌普萨拉周边的冰碛丘陵与林奈植物园生态，冰川遗留的鼓丘上混交林茂密，植物园引种世界各地植物，呈现北欧温带生态与植物学传统，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: The moraine hills and Linnaeus Garden ecology around Uppsala, mixed forest dense on glacial drumlins, the botanical garden acclimatizing plants from across the world, showing Nordic temperate ecology and a botanical tradition, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 瓦普堡之夜（Valborg），学生在河畔草坡点燃篝火合唱春歌，白帽与歌声，北欧迎接春天的传统与青春气息，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: On Valborg night, students lighting a bonfire on the riverside grassy slope and singing spring songs, white student caps and singing, the Nordic tradition and youthful spirit of welcoming spring, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 深秋林奈植物园，一张空长椅落在落叶铺地的林荫下，长椅上一本翻开的旧书，留白处是求知与静思的诗意，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: The Linnaeus Garden in deep autumn, an empty bench under a leaf-strewn canopy, an open old book on the seat, the negative space the poetry of seeking knowledge and quiet thought, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 乌普萨拉古坟与维京遗迹特写，皇家土丘上草皮覆顶，旁立一块刻着如尼文符文的古石，石面苔痕，北欧千年岁月的质感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Close-up of the Uppsala mounds and Viking relics, the royal burial mounds turfed over, a rune-inscribed standing stone beside them, moss on the stone, the weathered texture of a thousand Nordic years, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 透过斯塔万格老城区 Gamle Stavanger 一扇白漆木格窗望出去，窄窄的鹅卵石小巷两侧是一排排白色护墙板木屋，窗框与门楣带蓝灰色饰边，尽头是吕瑟峡湾的青灰山影，屋顶与远水中回响窗框的深普鲁士蓝，缀以暖白墙面与几点绿植，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: viewed through a white-painted wooden sash window of Gamle Stavanger old town, a narrow cobbled lane flanked by rows of white clapboard timber houses with blue-grey painted trim around doors and windows, the slate-green hills of Lysefjord beyond, the deep Prussian blue of the window frame echoed in rooftops and distant water, warmed by white walls and touches of green foliage, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 吕瑟峡湾的布道石 Preikestolen，一块被冰川切割出的平顶巨崖垂直悬于深冷峡湾之上六百余米，崖壁层理与冰川擦痕清晰，下方海水幽蓝，岩缝间生着苔藓与矮灌木，主色以深普鲁士蓝呼应窗框，辅以岩石暖灰与苔绿，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: Preikestolen the Pulpit Rock at Lysefjord, a flat-topped cliff block sheared by glaciers rising sheer over six hundred metres above the cold dark fjord, glacial striations and strata visible on the wall, deep blue water below, moss and dwarf shrubs in the cracks, deep Prussian blue echoing the frame, set against warm grey rock and moss green, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 斯塔万格彩色街 Øvre Holmegate 的午后，几位居民与游客在被刷成柔粉、鹅黄、薄荷绿的木屋之间漫步，遮阳伞下咖啡香气，地面微湿反光，暖白与彩色墙面里点缀窗框的深蓝阴影，温柔而有人气，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: an afternoon on Ovre Holmegate the colourful street of Stavanger, a few locals and visitors strolling between wooden houses painted soft pink, pale yellow and mint, cafe umbrellas, a faint scent of coffee, damp paving catching the light, warm walls accented by the deep blue shadow of the frame, gentle and lived-in, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 一幢孤独的白色木屋静立在安静的峡湾水边，屋前一张空长椅面朝水面，天光辽阔而苍白，几缕暖光掠过墙皮，深蓝的水与天呼应窗框，留出大片呼吸的空白，引人出神，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: a solitary white wooden house by the quiet fjord shore, an empty bench before it facing the water, the sky vast and pale, a few warm streaks grazing the paint, deep blue water and sky echoing the frame, wide breathing space left open, a scene to lose oneself in, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 斯塔万格罐头工业遗产特写，一只旧沙丁鱼铁罐与褪色的封罐标签平放在风化的木工作台上，金属边缘带着岁月锈痕与油污，是这座北海罐装之都的旧日气味，主色以锈暖与木褐为主，呼应窗框深蓝作冷调背景，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: a close-up of Stavanger canning heritage, an old sardine tin with a faded sealing label resting on a weathered wooden workbench, the metal rim worn with age rust and oil, the old scent of this North Sea canning capital, warm rust and wood brown as the main tones with the frame deep blue as a cool backdrop, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 透过阿克雷里一扇彩漆波纹铁皮屋的小窗望去，山坡上阿克雷里教堂 Akureyrarkirkja 阶梯状的白色混凝土塔楼静静立着，埃亚峡湾对岸是覆雪的山脊，窗框的冷石板灰在天光与远山中回响，缀以房屋的暖红与窗灯，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: through the small window of a painted corrugated-iron house in Akureyri, the stepped white concrete tower of Akureyrarkirkja stands on the hillside, snow-dusted ridges across Eyjafjordur, the cool slate grey of the frame echoed in the sky and far mountains, warmed by the houses red paint and window light, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 埃亚峡湾的座头鲸生态，一头座头鲸在平静如镜的峡湾水面扬起尾鳍，水花细碎，背景是白雪覆盖的山峰，海水深冷，画面以冷石板灰与深蓝为主呼应窗框，辅以鲸腹的暖白与水雾的微光，带一点原来如此的海洋生态知识感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: humpback whale ecology in Eyjafjordur, a humpback lifting its fluke over the mirror-calm fjord surface, fine spray, snow-covered peaks behind, cold deep sea, cool slate grey and deep blue as the main tones echoing the frame, with the warm white of the whale belly and a sheen on the mist, a quiet note of marine ecology, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 亚松森湾与巴拉圭河的湿地生态， flooded 的廊道林边一只 jabiru 鹳立于浅水，金色暮光铺在水面，主色以赭褐的岸与暖光呼应窗框，辅以水的冷蓝与林的深绿，带河流湿地生态知识感，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: the wetland ecology of the bay of Asuncion and the Paraguay river, a jabiru stork standing in the shallows by the flooded gallery forest, golden dusk light on the water, ochre brown banks and warm light echoing the frame, with cool blue water and deep green forest, a note on river wetland ecology, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 亚松森广场树荫下的温柔一刻，一小群人围坐分享 tereré 冰马黛茶，从 guampa 杯用 bombilla 吸管传递，lapacho 树投下凉荫，赭墙与暖光相映，呼应国民社交仪式，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: a gentle moment under a plaza tree in Asuncion, a small group sharing terere cold mate, passing the guampa cup with a bombilla straw, a lapacho tree casting cool shade, ochre wall in warm light, echoing the national social ritual, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 日落时分的亚松森湾空寂，红色的河水映着天光，一株蓝花楹只剩剪影，López 宫亮起暖灯，赭褐与冷蓝相映，留出关于河与母城的沉思留白，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: the empty bay of Asuncion at sunset, the red water reflecting the sky, a single jacaranda reduced to silhouette, the Palacio de Lopez lit warm, ochre brown against cool blue, musing space left on the river and the mother city, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage

items.zh: 呼应巴拉圭手艺的旧物特写，Itauguá 的 ñandutí 蛛网蕾丝，圆形的放射状编织在木框上呈现鲜艳的几何花纹，主色以暖赭褐呼应窗框，缀以蕾丝的冷蓝与品红，是 distinctive 的巴拉圭织艺凝缩，柔和水彩水粉手绘，细微纸纹，温润低饱和，方形构图，画面无任何文字
items.en: a close-up of a Paraguay craft object, the nanduti spiderweb lace of Itaugua, a circular radial weave on a wooden frame in vivid geometric patterns, warm ochre brown echoing the frame, with cool blue and magenta in the lace, a condensation of distinctive Paraguayan weaving, soft watercolor and gouache illustration, subtle paper grain, warm muted natural palette, painterly, square 1:1, no text, no words, no letters, no signage
